name: Jimdo
description_en:
Jimdo offers a hosted Website Builder for small businesses and a separate Creator editor with more manual control. The current Website Builder guides site creation and connects built-in tools such as forms, bookings and store operations; Creator is the documented option when custom code or external embed widgets are required.

Begin by identifying which editor and plan you actually have. The two products use different settings, help articles and cancellation steps. Free publishing and premium domain connection are documented, but numeric plan prices did not appear in the pricing page during either the text read or browser inspection, so this draft does not invent a current quote.
description_zh:
Jimdo 提供面向小企业的托管 Website Builder，并另有支持更多手动控制的 Creator 编辑器。当前 Website Builder 引导建站，并连接表单、预约和商店等内置工具；需要自定义代码或外部嵌入组件时，文档建议使用 Creator。

应先确认实际编辑器及方案。两个产品的设置、帮助文章和取消步骤不同。文档确认免费发布和付费域名连接，但定价页在文本及浏览器读取中均未显示具体套餐金额，因此本草稿不编造当前报价。

core_features.name_zh: 引导式与手动式编辑器
core_features.explanation_en: Website Builder uses guided setup; Creator offers hands-on element arrangement. Their account and help workflows differ.
core_features.explanation_zh: Website Builder 使用引导式设置，Creator 支持手动排列元素，两者账户和帮助流程不同。

core_features.explanation_en: Website Builder changes reach visitors only after Publish; the site can be unpublished if launched too early.
core_features.explanation_zh: Website Builder 的更改只有发布后访客才能看到，过早上线可取消发布。

core_features.name_en: Built-in features instead of arbitrary embeds
core_features.name_zh: 以内置能力替代任意嵌入
core_features.explanation_en: Website Builder does not accept custom HTML/CSS/JS, iframe or embed-code widgets; use supported Smart Apps or evaluate Creator.
core_features.explanation_zh: Website Builder 不接受自定义 HTML/CSS/JS、iframe 或嵌入代码组件，应使用支持的 Smart Apps 或评估 Creator。

pricing.summary_en: Free website publishing and paid premium/domain plans documented. Numeric current prices unavailable in the readable page; monthly or upfront 12/24-month terms and add-ons require an account quote.
pricing.summary_zh: 文档确认免费发布及付费高级/域名方案；可读页未显示当前金额，月付或预付 12/24 个月及附加项需账户报价。

sections.title_en: Identify Website Builder versus Creator first
sections.title_zh: 先识别 Website Builder 与 Creator
sections.en:
The official identification guide distinguishes builder.e.jimdo.com for Website Builder from cms.e.jimdo.com for Creator. Website Builder sites use a jimdosite.com subdomain; Creator may use jimdoweb.com or older jimdofree.com addresses. Website Builder has a fuller left dashboard with features depending on plan, whereas Creator editing uses a top menu. Check these indicators before following a domain, invoice, subscription or editing guide. A custom domain alone does not tell you which editor is underneath.

Primary evidence: [Which Jimdo product am I using? Creator or Website Builder – Jimdo Help Center](https://help.jimdo-dolphin.com/hc/en-us/articles/26910141624988-Which-Jimdo-product-am-I-using-Creator-or-Website-Builder).
sections.zh:
官方识别指南区分 Website Builder 的 builder.e.jimdo.com 与 Creator 的 cms.e.jimdo.com。前者使用 jimdosite.com 子域名，后者可能使用 jimdoweb.com 或旧 jimdofree.com。Website Builder 侧边面板较完整，具体功能取决于方案；Creator 编辑使用顶部菜单。执行域名、发票、订阅或编辑指南前应核对这些特征，仅凭自定义域名不能识别底层编辑器。

一手依据：[Which Jimdo product am I using? Creator or Website Builder – Jimdo Help Center](https://help.jimdo-dolphin.com/hc/en-us/articles/26910141624988-Which-Jimdo-product-am-I-using-Creator-or-Website-Builder)。

sections.title_zh: 有控制地完成首次发布
sections.en:
For Website Builder, choose the site in the account, click Edit Website and then Publish. The free address is a jimdosite.com subdomain; a Dolphin premium plan enables the custom domain described in the publication guide. You can keep editing an online site, but those changes become public only when published again. Inspect contact details, links, forms and mobile layouts before that action. Publication makes the domain accessible; it does not immediately put the site into Google results. No account or publication action was performed for this research.

Primary evidence: [How do I publish my Jimdo website? – Jimdo Help Center](https://help.jimdo-dolphin.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000897103-How-do-I-publish-my-Jimdo-website).
sections.zh:
Website Builder 的操作为在账户选择站点、点击 Edit Website，再点击 Publish。免费地址为 jimdosite.com 子域名；发布指南称 Dolphin 付费方案可使用自定义域名。线上站点可继续编辑，但更改需再次发布才公开。执行前应检查联系方式、链接、表单及手机布局。发布令域名可访问，不等于立即出现在 Google 搜索。本次研究未执行账户或发布操作。

一手依据：[How do I publish my Jimdo website? – Jimdo Help Center](https://help.jimdo-dolphin.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000897103-How-do-I-publish-my-Jimdo-website)。

sections.title_en: Decide whether built-in integrations are sufficient
sections.title_zh: 判断内置集成是否足够
sections.en:
Website Builder explicitly disallows custom HTML, CSS, JavaScript, iframes and external widgets added through embed code. Its support article instead points to Smart Apps for supported media/social/form use cases, Jimdo Bookings for appointments, and domain settings for external email. Code-free Search Console verification is also documented as an alternative to injecting tags. If a must-have booking engine, script or bespoke layout requires code, evaluate Creator before buying; Creator’s code support does not establish automatic conversion of an existing Builder site or equivalence of all features.

Primary evidence: [Adding custom code or external widgets in Jimdo Website Builder – Jimdo Help Center](https://help.jimdo-dolphin.com/hc/en-us/articles/26931604070044-Adding-custom-code-or-external-widgets-in-Jimdo-Website-Builder).
sections.zh:
Website Builder 明确禁止自定义 HTML、CSS、JavaScript、iframe 和通过代码嵌入外部组件。支持文章建议用 Smart Apps 处理受支持的媒体/社交/表单场景，以 Jimdo Bookings 处理预约，通过域名设置连接外部邮件，也提供无需插入标签的 Search Console 验证路径。如必需的预约引擎、脚本或特殊布局依赖代码，应在购买前评估 Creator；Creator 支持代码不代表已有 Builder 站点可自动转换，也不代表全部功能等价。

一手依据：[Adding custom code or external widgets in Jimdo Website Builder – Jimdo Help Center](https://help.jimdo-dolphin.com/hc/en-us/articles/26931604070044-Adding-custom-code-or-external-widgets-in-Jimdo-Website-Builder)。

sections.title_en: Confirm the quote and consumer/business distinction
sections.title_zh: 确认报价及消费者/企业差异
sections.en: The official pricing FAQ permits upgrading a Free website and says premium customers can transfer a domain or keep the registrar and connect it. It describes monthly payment or upfront 12/24-month terms, but no numeric plan prices were exposed in the captured page or normal browser view. Confirm the country, currency, tax, term, domain renewal and add-on quote in the account before choosing. The page’s 14-day withdrawal statement is conditional on statutory consumer rights in the customer’s country and explicitly excludes businesses; do not present it as a universal business trial/refund promise.
sections.zh: 官方定价 FAQ 允许免费站升级，称付费客户可转入域名或保留注册商仅连接域名，并描述月付或预付 12/24 个月期限，但实读页面及正常浏览器视图未显示具体方案价格。选择前应在账户确认国家、货币、税费、期限、域名续费及附加项报价。页面的 14 天撤回声明以客户所在国家的法定消费者权利为条件，并明确排除企业，不能写成普遍适用的企业试用/退款承诺。

sections.en:
For Website Builder annual renewals, the cancellation guide sets the last cancellation date one month before renewal, with no partial early-cancellation refund unless the terms provide one. The dashboard route is Plan & Billing → Manage Subscription → Cancel Plan; domain retention is a separate choice, and confirmation/authcode arrives by email where requested. The site remains available as Free, and some registrars may require further domain cancellation or transfer steps. Jimdo is a plausible fit for a small business accepting guided layouts and built-in services. Custom-app hosting, source export, open-source licensing and complete customer-data migration are not established here; verify those before relying on an exit path.

Primary evidence: [How do I cancel my Jimdo subscription? – Jimdo Help Center](https://help.jimdo-dolphin.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000898383-How-do-I-cancel-my-Jimdo-subscription).

Primary evidence: [Which Jimdo product am I using? Creator or Website Builder – Jimdo Help Center](https://help.jimdo-dolphin.com/hc/en-us/articles/26910141624988-Which-Jimdo-product-am-I-using-Creator-or-Website-Builder).
sections.zh:
Website Builder 年续费的取消指南将最后期限设为续费前一个月，提前取消不按比例退款，除非条款另有规定。面板路径为 Plan & Billing → Manage Subscription → Cancel Plan；是否保留域名单独选择，确认及按需提供的转移码通过邮件发送。网站继续以 Free 形式存在，某些注册商可能还需要额外域名取消或转移步骤。接受引导布局和内置服务的小企业可考虑 Jimdo。这里未确立自定义应用托管、源码导出、开源许可或完整客户数据迁移，应在依赖退出路径前核实。

一手依据：[How do I cancel my Jimdo subscription? – Jimdo Help Center](https://help.jimdo-dolphin.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000898383-How-do-I-cancel-my-Jimdo-subscription)。

一手依据：[Which Jimdo product am I using? Creator or Website Builder – Jimdo Help Center](https://help.jimdo-dolphin.com/hc/en-us/articles/26910141624988-Which-Jimdo-product-am-I-using-Creator-or-Website-Builder)。
